svg.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Cumulative Test team ratings (every Test counts), 1877 to 28 Oct 2026
Average match score over every Test a team has played to date, with no fading of old results.
Each team's rating at the end of every year it played Tests (2,660 Tests in all). Lines run straight across years with no Tests. Dashed grey line = 100, the starting rating.

Source: ESPNcricinfo Statsguru. Scoring: default points system of the Test Team Ratings app (cumulative average; each team starts with 10 Tests at its starting rating; same-strength band ±4). ICC World XI (1 Test) not shown.
